annotations.title: Get trade show exhibitor lists (booths and contacts)

description: Exhibitor lists of trade shows as B2B leads: company, booth and hall, email, phone, website, address, socials and categories. 91 built-in shows (e.g. medica, sema-show, nab-show, fabtech, ish, automechanika, wtm-london, orgatec, eurotier, wine-paris, biofach) or any exhibitor-list link or show homepage on Messe Frankfurt, Messe Düsseldorf, Koelnmesse, NürnbergMesse, Newfront/ExpoPlatform, RX, Map Your Show, a2z / A2Z Connect, Swapcard or Corussoft; the link's own show and year are used. Contact coverage depends on what the organiser publishes. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/exhibition-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.002 per exhibitor; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

changes_only.description: Only exhibitors that are new, changed (old and new booth, email, phone, website, address) or removed since the last call with the same shows. Removed ones need the whole list, so it ignores max_items for that.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

include_contacts.description: Open each exhibitor profile for email, phone, website, address and socials. Off = names and booths only (faster).

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 2000). Cost scales with this.

shows.description: Built-in show ids, e.g. ["medica","sema-show"]. The Actor README lists all ids.

urls.description: Links to any show's exhibitor list or exhibitor search page (or its homepage).

name: get_trade_show_exhibitors

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.
